## Problem and resulting behavior

Include a minimal before/after example and any public API or wire-format implications.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass and new regressions fail without the fix.
- [ ] Original validation and explicit unsupported-schema handling remain intact.
- [ ] Historical benchmark data is preserved; new measurements are separate.
- [ ] Provider evidence, if any, names the model, settings, corpus, cost and limitations.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, private chats or internal planning are included.

## Tradeoffs

Describe dependency, runtime, token-overhead or compatibility changes. Leave unchecked items explained rather than claiming checks that were not run.
